text: Anyone in San Antonio can now hail a Waymo with no driver,
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
The recall says the software may let a car slow,
and every affected car had the update by April twentieth.
observed: A feed-safe-area composite with two rows of the same five frames inside green boxes: curb, creek, road with recall card, depot, credits. Captions sit at the bottom of each green box and stay inside the safe area. Outside the boxes red shaded bands mark the platform-obscured zones, and the lower portion of every frame outside the box is empty. Text on cards is small at this size but headline captions are legible.
